title: Privacy Policy
content:
This privacy policy outlines how SAHA TEXTILE uses and safeguards any information provided by users when accessing the SAHA TEXTILE website.

SAHA TEXTILE is dedicated to ensuring the protection of your privacy. When prompted to provide identifiable information while using the website, rest assured that it will be used in strict accordance with this privacy statement.

SAHA TEXTILE reserves the right to update this policy periodically. Users are advised to check this page regularly to stay informed and content with any modifications.

Information We Collect:

  • Name
  • Contact information (email address, phone number)
  • Demographic details (postcode, preferences, interests)
  • Other data pertaining to customer surveys and offers

How We Utilize Your Information:

We gather this information to comprehend your requirements and enhance the quality of service we provide, notably for the following purposes:

  • Internal record-keeping
  • Enhancing products and services
  • Sending promotional emails about new products, special offers, and relevant information using the provided email address
  • Using the information for market research activities and customizing the website to align with your preferences

We are committed to maintaining the security of your information through appropriate measures to prevent unauthorized access or disclosure.

Cookies Usage:

Cookies are small files that seek your permission to be stored on your computer’s hard drive. These files aid in analyzing web traffic and recognizing site visits. Cookies enable web applications to personalize operations based on your preferences by gathering and retaining information about you.

Our use of traffic log cookies identifies pages being visited to analyze webpage traffic, enhancing website customization to suit customer needs. This information is solely used for statistical analysis and then removed from the system.

Cookies facilitate the provision of an improved website experience by allowing us to monitor pages that are useful to you. They do not grant access to your computer or provide information beyond what you choose to share with us.

Users can opt to accept or decline cookies. While most web browsers automatically accept cookies, settings can typically be adjusted to decline them if preferred, potentially affecting full website functionality.

Controlling Your Personal Information:

Users can limit the collection or utilization of personal information in the following ways:

  • When filling out website forms, look for the option indicating a refusal for the information to be used for direct marketing purposes
  • If prior consent for the use of personal information for direct marketing purposes was given, users can revoke it at any time by contacting us via email at wecare@sahatextile.com

We do not trade, distribute, or lease personal information to third parties without explicit permission or legal necessity. Your personal information might be utilized to send promotional information about third-party services if you have expressed interest in such communications.

Should you discover any incorrect or incomplete information being held about you, please promptly notify us via email or mail to correct the inaccuracies.

Thank you.
